notes:
Check first:
(1) n=1002 'Piva Beeride', n=1450 'hea Head' and n=1452 'iio' are unresolved garbles. I marked them none only because there was no better kind. Read the scans.
(2) n=881 'N. Uist': I gave it to N. Unst (muckle-flugga) because it's in the East Coast section. If the scan really says North Uist, change it to a place.
(3) n=1321 'Whalsey Head': I gave it to the Whalsey Skerries light (out-skerries), but it could be a headland on Whalsay island.
(4) n=1291 'Tyree': I made it a place, but it could be the Hynish Signal Tower station.
(5) n=1140 'Sound (?)': I made it a place near Lerwick, but it could be Bressay Sound, which would make it the bressay station.
(6) The faroe and iceland stations are listed only for 1885m and 1887m. The 1882–83 Faroe and Iceland items, especially Thorshavn and Stykkishólmur, are made places. Change them if those stations are the same sites.
(7) n=753 Lerwick (12 observations) is a town correspondent. Check that none are Bressay lighthouse returns.

Less certain place guesses: Caldarvon → Caldarvan, Gauredal → Gásadalur, Tofle → Toftir, Vaay in Bordo → Vágur/Klaksvík, Latham Moss → Letham Moss in Stirlingshire (not Lathom in Lancashire), Redcastle (Black Isle or Angus), Tyne Woods (East Lothian), Garden estate.

Ship positions are made places described as 'At sea'. Change them to none if you prefer. n=19 and n=27 have impossible minutes ('85° 89'' and '69° 87'') and need the scan.
